# Known cross-test UpdateQueue leaks (#1166). Generated by:
#   ./build/bin/helix-tests "~[.] ~[slow]" 2>&1 | tee run.log
#   scripts/check_update_queue_leaks.py --write-baseline <this file> run.log
#
# Each leak is keyed by ATTRIBUTION QUALITY, not by who it landed on:
#   tag:<producer>  a queue_update() site that passes a tag. The victim test is
#                   deliberately not recorded — the producer is stable, but the
#                   victim is whichever test drained next, and the debounce-driven
#                   producers move between victims on wall-clock timing (#1170).
#   test:<name>     an <untagged> producer. Nothing better to key on, and stable:
#                   untagged producers are not timer-driven.
#
# A key NOT listed here fails the build. The list may SHRINK as leaks are fixed;
# it must not grow. Regenerate rather than hand-editing.
#
# The ceiling below catches an EXTRA untagged callback appearing inside a test
# that is already listed, which the key set alone would miss. Untagged callbacks
# totalled exactly 717 across four identical runs; the tagged total flapped.
max-untagged-callbacks: 239
